title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00006 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
06:45 - 09:30: Waited for supply vessel to arrive with straddle equipment. Meanwhile, skidded rig to f-11.
09:30 - 10:00: Vessel arrived rig with equipment.
10:00 - 12:15: Checked and verified the received straddle equipment OK.
12:15 - 16:30: Waited while production department prepared well for handover. Meanwhile, cleaned and tidy rig floor and pipe deck.
16:30 - 16:45: Received well from production department.
16:45 - 17:30: Replaced permanent hatch with WL hatch
17:30 - 18:00: Inflow tested SV and TKV on XMT. Leak tested KWV to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min.
18:00 - 18:30: Hooked up chiksan manifold on KW and leak tested same to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min.
18:30 - 18:40: Removed top cap on XMT.
18:40 - 19:45: Lifted riser section and BOP from moonpool area and landed on XMT.
19:45 - 20:35: Connected hoses for test pump and local control of DHSV and HMV on XMT.
20:35 - 20:45: Held toolbox talk prior to lifting lubricator and GIH.
20:45 - 21:20: Lifted lubricator and GIH from catwalk and hung off same above riser section on drill floor.
21:20 - 22:45: M/u BHA for run w/ tractor) in lubricator. Added 80 l starlube in riser before stabbing lubricator. Filled lubricator with MEG. Attempted to leak test rig-up to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min. Dicovered leakage in GIH due to error in grease pump.
22:45 - 00:00: Waited while altus and maersk mechanic fixed grease pump.
